summary: The customer called feeling angry and upset about a high bill and the sudden threat of service disconnection, requesting a two-week payment extension until their payday. The agent initially offered only five days due to company policy, but after the customer expressed frustration, the agent successfully performed an override to grant a ten-week extension until the 15th of the month. The call ended cordially with the customer satisfied.

evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Extended the payment deadline to the 15th of the month.

evidence.text: أكيد يا سيدي، ما رح يكون في أي إشي

rubric_scores.justification: The agent remained calm, polite, and respectful throughout the call despite the customer's initial anger.
